reask.hi: Do ek jaisi roti mein se ek 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai aur ek 5 mein; roti zyada chahiye, toh ek hissa kaunsa loge, 1/10 ya 1/5?

why.hi: 5 hisson wali roti ka 1/5, 10 hisson wali roti ke 1/10 se do guna bada hai

whyShort.hi: 1/12 sabse chhota, 1/6 beech mein, 1/3 sabse bada

whyAlt.en: Start from the smallest; and a bigger bottom number does not make a bigger part. Share one whole among 12 people and each share is much smaller than a share among 3.

answerViewCaption.hi: Teen ek jaisi patti hain: ek 12 barabar hisson mein, ek 6 mein, ek 3 mein, aur har patti ka ek hissa rangeen hai. 12 wali patti ka rangeen hissa sabse chhota hai aur 3 wali ka sabse bada, isliye order hai 1/12, 1/6, 1/3.

simpler.hi: Ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Isi baat se teeno fraction ke neeche wale number milao.
simpler.en: The more equal parts one whole is cut into, the smaller each part is. Use that to compare the bottom numbers of the three fractions.

why.en: This first mark is at the end of the first of the three gaps from 0 to 1, so it is the mark of 1/3, not of 1/5. Now think whether 1/5 comes before it or past it.

viewCaption.hi: Line yahan ek patti ban gayi hai, teen barabar hisson mein, aur pehle hisse mein rang hai: woh rangeen hissa line ka pehla gap hai.

why.hi: yeh mark 1/3 hai, aur 1/5 usse chhota fraction hai, isliye 0 se chalte hue 1/5 is mark se pehle aata
why.en: this mark is 1/3, and 1/5 is a smaller fraction than it, so walking from 0, 1/5 comes before this mark

whyShort.hi: yeh mark 1/3 hai; 1/5 ka gap isse chhota hota
whyShort.en: this mark is 1/3; a 1/5 gap would be smaller

answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 3 equal parts, and the first part is coloured, 1/3. A 1/5 part would be smaller, so 1/5 would come before this colour ends.

prompt.hi: Do ek jitni lambi dor: ek 9 barabar hisson mein kati, doosri 11 mein. Kis dor ka ek hissa chhota hai?

reask.hi: 9 aur 11 barabar hisson mein kati ek jitni do dor mein se kis dor ka ek hissa chhota hai?

why.hi: 11 hisse 9 se zyada hain, toh 11 wali dor ka hissa 1/11, 1/9 se chhota hai
why.en: 11 parts are more than 9, so the 11-part string's part, 1/11, is smaller than 1/9

whyShort.hi: zyada hisse, chhota hissa: 1/11, 1/9 se chhota
whyShort.en: more parts, smaller part: 1/11 is smaller than 1/9

whyAlt.hi: Chhota 9 chhota hissa nahi banata; 9 bas ginta hai ki dor kitne hisson mein kati. Ek hi dor ke hisse jitne kam, har hissa utna lamba.
whyAlt.en: A small 9 does not make a small part; 9 only counts how many parts the string is cut into. The fewer parts one string has, the longer each part.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar 9 barabar gap hain, neeche 11. Neeche ka pehla mark, 1/11, upar ke pehle mark se 0 ke zyada paas hai, isliye 11 wali dor ka hissa chhota hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Above the line are 9 equal gaps, below it 11. The first mark below, 1/11, is closer to 0 than the first mark above, so a part of the 11 string is smaller.

simpler.hi: Dono dor ek jitni lambi hain; socho ki kis dor par zyada baar kainchi chali.

why.hi: pehli patti 2/7 thi; hisse wahi 7 hain aur rang ab 4 mein hai, toh 4/7

reask.en: 2/3 of one strip and 3/10 of another strip the same size: which is bigger?

why.hi: 2/3 aadhe se aage nikal jaata hai, aur 3/10 aadhe tak bhi nahi pahunchta

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaise gol hain, ek teen barabar hisson mein aur ek paanch mein; dono ka ek-ek hissa rangeen hai.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles, one in three equal parts and one in five; one part of each is coloured.

say.hi: Do ek jitni patti hain, ek 3 barabar hisson mein aur ek 5 mein, toh 3 wali ka har hissa bada hai. Dono mein utne hi hisse rangein, toh 3 wali mein rang zyada hoga.
say.en: There are two strips of the same length, one in 3 equal parts and one in 5, so each part of the 3 strip is bigger. Colour the same number of parts in both, and the 3 strip will have more colour.

simpler.hi: Ginti dono taraf barabar hai, toh faisla hisse ki lambai karegi. Ek-ek hissa saath rakh kar milao.
simpler.en: The count is the same on both sides, so the length of a part decides. Put one part next to one and compare.

prompt.hi: Ravi ne deewar ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 4 range, Kavya ne waisi deewar ke 10 mein se 4. Kam rang kiski deewar par?
prompt.en: Ravi painted 4 of a wall's 6 equal parts, Kavya 4 of 10 on a wall like it. Whose wall has less paint?

reask.hi: Ravi ne deewar ka 4/6 rang diya aur Kavya ne utni hi badi deewar ka 4/10, toh kam rang kiski deewar par hai?
reask.en: Ravi painted 4/6 of a wall and Kavya 4/10 of a wall just as big, so whose wall has less paint?

viewCaption.hi: Dono deewar ki jagah yahan do ek jaise gol hain, ek 6 barabar hisson mein aur ek 10 mein; dono ke chaar-chaar hisse dekho.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles stand in for the two walls here, one in 6 equal parts and one in 10; look at four parts of each.

why.hi: dono deewar par chaar-chaar hisse, lekin 1/10 wala hissa 1/6 wale se chhota, isliye 4/10 kam, yaani Kavya ki deewar
why.en: 4 parts on each wall, but a 1/10 part is smaller than a 1/6 one, so 4/10 is less: Kavya's wall

whyShort.hi: 1/10 ka hissa chhota, isliye 4/10 kam hai
whyShort.en: a 1/10 part is smaller, so 4/10 is less

whyAlt.hi: Chaar-chaar hisse hain, par rang barabar nahi: deewar jitne zyada hisson mein bati ho, uska har hissa utna patla hota hai.
whyAlt.en: Four parts each, but not equal paint: the more parts a wall is split into, the thinner each part.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar mark 4/6 par hai, neeche 4/10 par. 4/10 ka mark peeche hai, isliye Kavya ki deewar par kam rang hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Above the line the mark is at 4/6, below it at 4/10. The 4/10 mark is further back, so Kavya's wall has less paint.

simpler.hi: Chaar hisse toh dono deewar par hain. Ab bas ek-ek hisse ka size milao: 6 mein bati deewar ka, aur 10 mein bati deewar ka.
simpler.en: Both walls have four parts painted. Now just compare the size of one part each: of the wall in 6, and of the wall in 10.

sayAlt.hi: Papa aur ek chhota bachcha dono apne joote se paanch-paanch baar kamra naapein, toh Papa ke paanch joote zyada lambai naapte hain, kyunki unka har joota bada hai.
sayAlt.en: If a father and a small child each measure a room five shoe-lengths with their own shoes, the father's five cover more, because each of his shoes is bigger.

remediation.move: a different case in words: identical ropes cut into 2 and 8, four 8-parts make one 2-part → the bigger number has the smaller parts; then-card: two equal roads in 4 and 12 parts, 3 built of each, did the first team build more (left to the child)

viewCaption.hi: Yahan do ek jaisi rassiyon ki jagah do gol hain: ek do barabar hisson mein, ek aath mein.
viewCaption.en: Here two circles stand for two identical ropes: one in two equal parts, one in eight.

say.hi: Do ek jaisi rassi: 2 hisson wali ke ek hisse mein, 8 hisson wali ke chaar aate hain, isliye 8 wala hissa chhota hai.
say.en: Two identical ropes: one part of the rope in 2 holds four of the rope in 8, so the 8 one's part is smaller.

simpler.hi: Number bada hone se hissa bada nahi hota; jitne zyada hisse, har hissa utna chhota.
simpler.en: A bigger number doesn't make a bigger part; the more parts, the smaller each one.

prompt.hi: Do ek si sadak: pehli team ne 4 barabar hisson mein se 3 banaye, doosri ne 12 mein se 3. Kisne zyada, pehli ya doosri?
prompt.en: Two equal roads: the first team built 3 of 4 equal parts, the second 3 of 12. Who built more, the first or the second?

reask.hi: Ek jaisi do sadak mein se pehli team ne 3/4 banayi aur doosri ne 3/12; zyada sadak kisne banayi, pehli ya doosri?
reask.en: Of two equal roads, the first team built 3/4 and the second 3/12; who built more road, the first or the second?

viewCaption.hi: Sadak ki jagah do ek jaise gol hain, ek 4 barabar hisson mein aur ek 12 mein. 4 wale gol ka ek hissa 12 wale gol ke kitne hisson jitna hai, yeh gino.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles stand in for the roads, one in 4 equal parts and one in 12. Count how many parts of the 12-circle one part of the 4-circle equals.

why.hi: dono ne teen-teen hisse banaye, par 1/4 ka hissa 1/12 se bada hai, isliye pehli team ne zyada banayi
why.en: both built 3 parts, but a 1/4 part is bigger than a 1/12 part, so the first team built more

whyShort.hi: 1/4 ka hissa 1/12 se bada hai
whyShort.en: a 1/4 part is bigger than a 1/12 part

whyAlt.hi: 12 bada number hai, par uske hisse chhote hain: 4 hisson wali sadak ka ek hissa, 12 wali ke kai hisson jitna lamba hota hai.
whyAlt.en: 12 is a bigger number, but its parts are small: one part of a road in 4 is as long as several parts of a road in 12.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar mark 3/4 par hai, neeche 3/12 par. 3/4 ka mark bahut aage hai, isliye pehli team ne zyada sadak banayi.
answerViewCaption.en: Above the line the mark is at 3/4, below it at 3/12. The 3/4 mark is far ahead, so the first team built more road.

simpler.hi: Teen-teen toh dono team ne banaye; ab 4 hisson wali sadak ka ek hissa aur 12 hisson wali sadak ka ek hissa saath rakh kar dekho.
simpler.en: Both teams built three anyway; now put one part of the road in 4 beside one part of the road in 12.

sayAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi bottle hain. Ek ka paani 3 glass mein baanto, doosri ka 6 mein. Toh 6 mein se har glass ko, 3 mein se har glass ka aadha paani milta hai.
sayAlt.en: There are two identical bottles. Share one into 3 glasses, the other into 6. So each of the 6 glasses gets half the water of each of the 3.

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaisi bottle ka paani yahan do gol hain: ek teen barabar hisson mein, ek chhe mein.
viewCaption.en: The water of two identical bottles is two circles here: one in three equal parts, one in six.

remediation.move: a different case in words: identical boxes with 3 and 8 equal sections, each one section short → the 3-section is bigger → the smaller shortfall is closer to full; then-card: two glasses 4/5 and 5/6 full, which needs less juice to fill (left to the child)

say.hi: Do ek jaise dibbe, 3 aur 8 khaanon ke, ek-ek khaana khaali. 3 wale ka khaana bada, toh 8 wala bharne ke zyada paas.
say.en: Two identical boxes, of 3 and 8 compartments, one compartment empty in each. The 3 box's compartment is bigger, so the 8 box is nearer to full.

simpler.hi: Dono dibbon mein ek-ek khaana khaali hai, par khaanon ka size alag hai; dono khaali khaanon ka size milao.
simpler.en: Each box has one empty section, but the sections differ in size; compare the sizes of the two empty sections.

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaise dibbe gol ban gaye hain: ek teen barabar khaanon mein, ek aath mein; dono mein ek-ek khaana khaali.
viewCaption.en: Two identical boxes are circles here: one in three equal sections, one in eight; each has one section empty.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise glass: ek 5 mein se 4 tak bhara, doosra 6 mein se 5 tak. Kise poora karne mein kam juice lagega?
prompt.en: Two same glasses: one filled to 4 of 5 parts, the other to 5 of 6. Which needs less juice to be full?

reask.hi: 4/5 aur 5/6 bhare do ek jaise glass mein se kis glass ko poora karne mein kam juice lagega?
reask.en: Of two identical glasses filled 4/5 and 5/6, which needs less juice to fill?

viewCaption.hi: Dono glass yahan do ek jaise gol hain, ek 5 barabar hisson mein aur ek 6 mein; har gol ka ek hissa utna hai jitna us glass mein khaali hai.
viewCaption.en: The two glasses are two identical circles here, one in 5 equal parts and one in 6; one part of each circle is as much as is empty in that glass.

why.hi: 5/6 wale glass ka khaali hissa bas 1/6 hai, 4/5 wale ka 1/5, aur 1/6 chhota hai
why.en: the 5/6 glass's empty part is only 1/6, the 4/5 glass's is 1/5, and 1/6 is smaller

whyShort.hi: 5/6 ka khaali hissa bas 1/6, jo chhota hai
whyShort.en: 5/6's empty part is only 1/6, the smaller one

whyAlt.hi: Ek-ek hissa khaali dekh kar barabar lagta hai, par 5 mein bate glass ka ek hissa aur 6 mein bate glass ka ek hissa ek jitne nahi hote.
whyAlt.en: One empty part each makes it look equal, but one part of a glass split into 5 and one part of a glass split into 6 are not the same size.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar mark 4/5 par hai, neeche 5/6 par. 5/6 ka mark 1 ke zyada paas hai, isliye us glass ko poora karne mein kam juice lagega.
answerViewCaption.en: Above the line the mark is at 4/5, below it at 5/6. The 5/6 mark is closer to 1, so that glass needs less juice to fill.

simpler.hi: Dono glass mein ek-ek hissa khaali hai; socho ki 5 mein bate glass ka ek hissa bada hai ya 6 mein bate ka.
simpler.en: Each glass has one empty part; think whether a part of the glass in 5 or of the glass in 6 is bigger.

sayAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi bhari tanki socho: ek se ek bada lota paani nikala, doosri se ek chhota lota; chhote lote wali tanki mein zyada paani bacha.
sayAlt.en: Picture two identical full tanks: one big jug of water taken from one, one small jug from the other; the tank that lost the small jug has more water left.

covered.hi: Aakhir mein dekha: hisson ki ginti same ho, toh jiske hisse bade, wahi fraction zyada hota hai.
covered.en: Last we saw: when the count of parts is the same, the fraction with the bigger parts is more.
